title: Balanced Masala Beans
subtitle: with Grains, Coriander and Pickled Onion
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

ingredients.name: Brown and Black Rice with Quinoa

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil for the rice blend. Thinly slice the onion. Trim the green beans and halve on an angle. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Reserve a few coriander leaves, then coarsely chop the remaining leaves and finely chop the stems. Drain and rinse the kidney beans.

Cook rice blend: Add the rice blend to the pan of boiling water and cook for 22-24 mins until tender. Drain. Meanwhile, combine 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 1 tsp sugar in a bowl. Add half the onion and toss to combine. Set aside to pickle, tossing occasionally, until needed.

Cook aromatics: Heat 1 tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Add the garlic, coriander stems, masala seasoning and remaining onion and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until the onion is softened. Add the kidney beans, tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar and 180ml (¾ cup) water and bring to the boil.

Simmer curry: Reduce the heat to medium and cook the curry, stirring occasionally, for 8 mins or until the sauce is thickened. Add the green beans and chopped coriander leaves and cook for 5 mins or until the green beans are tender. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Drain the onion, reserving the pickling liquid. Divide the rice blend and masala beans among bowls. Top with the pickled onion and reserved coriander leaves. Drizzle with the pickling liquid and enjoy!
Make it spicy: Like it hot? Kick up the heat a notch or two with a scattering of chopped fresh chilli or chilli flakes.
